intent: How far an agent may go without asking: four readable stops on a kit SegmentedControl, with the current stop explained below.
useWhen: set an agent's autonomy level in settings or before a run
show a policy-locked autonomy level and why
save a new level with a visible saving state
doNotUseWhen: a numeric value on a range — Slider

options.note: { id, label, description, icon? }[] from more oversight to more autonomy. Default ask · risk · tell · run (exported as AUTONOMY_STOPS).

disabledReason.note: e.g. "Set by workspace policy" with a lock.

saving.note: The selected stop's icon spins; the panel shows Saving…

requirements: the stops are a kit SegmentedControl (role=radiogroup, arrow keys) described by the panel
tick dots and end labels are aria-hidden
no primary Button; the control saves on change
motion is opacity and transform, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local AutonomyDial, AutonomySlider, or TrustLevel picker
Do not use a Slider for autonomy stops
Do not add a Save primary Button
